entities.summary: Pelle Miljoona (b. 1955-02-10, Hamina) was a visual artist or sculptor of the Contemporary era, characterized by technology, globalization, and rapid social change, active in Hamina and Finland. Known in the fields of finland, composers & musicians, europe.
